Medicare Open Enrollment Update
Posted on October 19, 2026
It’s a big year for Medicare changes and BCBS canceled a very popular plan (after canceling one last year too!) leaving many seniors scrambling for support to make a new choice for 2027. Our Council on Aging (COA) is fully booked and has a wait list. We aren't alone - almost all COAs in the...
Spotted Lanternfly in Princeton
Posted on October 18, 2026
The Mass. Dept. of Agricultural Resources (MDAR) recently confirmed an infestation of the invasive insect known as spotted lanternfly (Lycorma delicatula or “SLF”) in Princeton. Members of their survey team were following up on reports that came in to their pest reporting website in September and October, and confirmed a population of spotted lanternfly adults....
Leominster Trail Master Plan Public Comment Period Ends 10/22
Posted on October 18, 2026
DCR held its public meeting about the Leominster State Forest Trail Master Plan and it is now the public comment period.
